title: Apparently, Everybody on YouTube Is a Millionaire: A Realistic Guide to Building Something
description: Everyone on YouTube made $10,000 last month. Apparently. You didn't. Neither did I. This book is for the rest of us — the ones with a 9-to-5, a half-finished Etsy shop, a course we bought and never opened, and a sneaking suspicion that "revenue" and "profit" are not, in fact, the same word. Apparently, Everybody on YouTube Is a Millionaire is a realistic (and occasionally unhinged) guide to building something on the side — a business, a brand, a little extra income — without losing your mind, your money, or your Tuesday. Inside, you'll find: Why "I made $100,000!" and "I kept $100,000" are two very different sentences What happens when AI enters the chat (and whether it's actually helping) Why you don't need seven streams of income — you need one stream to stop acting stupid A permission slip to stop treating your side hustle like it has to become an empire Zero secret formulas, zero "I made this while sleeping" nonsense, and one very tired 9-to-5 employee's honest take on what actually works If you've ever closed a "make $500 a day with Canva" video feeling worse than when you opened it, this book is for you. Come for the humor.
